Pre-2026 retirees seek clarity on 8th Pay Commission pension hike 
 inshorts Pre-2026 retirees seek clarity on 8th Pay Commission pension hike
 Central government employees who retired before Jan 1, 2026, are seeking clarity on pension revision under 8th Pay Commission. Pensioner associations have urged government to amend Commission's Terms of Reference to explicitly include past retirees. The Department of Personnel and Training has forwarded their representations to Department of Expenditure, but no final decision has been announced. tap for more at Asianet Newsable yesterday Tap to know more Will Retired Employees Get Pension Hike?
